children: Having joined the company in 2024, she previously served as the AVP - Marketing
Firstsource Solutions has elevated Aditi Bhandari to Vice President – Marketing, marking a step up from her previous role as Associate Vice President – Marketing.

Bhandari joined Firstsource in August 2024 and has been associated with the company’s marketing function for over two years. In her expanded role, she will continue to work across the company’s marketing and brand initiatives.

Before joining Firstsource, Bhandari held marketing leadership roles at Startek, Conduent and RateGain. Her experience spans brand, marketing communications and strategic marketing across the business services and technology ecosystem.

Bhandari’s elevation comes as Firstsource continues to strengthen its positioning as a technology-led business process management company, with AI and digital transformation playing an increasingly central role in its proposition.
Her appointment adds to the company’s marketing leadership as it looks to build greater visibility around its capabilities and differentiated offerings.
